title: Use Seedance 2.5 to transform unrendered 3D blockouts into finished cinematic…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 to transform unrendered 3D blockouts into finished cinematic animation while preserving precise 3D tracking and camera motion.  
Use Seedance 2.5 to convert raw 3D geometry into detailed textures and lighting for a finished look.  
Use Seedance 2.5 to add dynamic VFX (fire, smoke, water) during the blockout-to-cinematic animation pass.
